display.purpose: Page titles and hero statements only; balanced line breaks.

body.purpose: All paragraphs and descriptions; 65ch measure for long-form.

label.purpose: Form labels, table heads, small buttons; sentence case, never uppercase.

motion.name: ease-out-expo
motion.purpose: Entrances and lifts; settles fast, lands soft.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Under prefers-reduced-motion: no spatial movement, no infinite loops, instant feedback.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one loud action on a surface; Harbor Blue fill, darkens on hover, presses down on click.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn ds-btn-primary"><svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M5 12h14"/><path d="m12 5 7 7-7 7"/></svg>Search</button>
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; padding: 8px 16px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid transparent; font: 500 0.875rem/1.4 'Figtree', system-ui, sans-serif; white-space: nowrap; background: oklch(0.545 0.180 250); color: rgb(248 250 253); cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.65, 0, 0.35, 1), transform 120ms cubic-bezier(0.65, 0, 0.35, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: oklch(0.500 0.170 250); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.98); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(0.545 0.180 250); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; transform: none; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Sunken fill with a field-strength edge; hover brightens only the border.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; padding: 8px 16px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid oklch(0.520 0.024 245); font: 500 0.875rem/1.4 'Figtree', system-ui, sans-serif; white-space: nowrap; background: oklch(0.255 0.016 245); color: oklch(0.920 0.010 245); cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.65, 0, 0.35, 1), transform 120ms cubic-bezier(0.65, 0, 0.35, 1); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color: oklch(0.600 0.026 245); } .ds-btn-secondary:active { transform: scale(0.98); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(0.545 0.180 250); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Transparent until hovered; reveals a sunken field and steps text up.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; padding: 8px 16px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid transparent; font: 500 0.875rem/1.4 'Figtree', system-ui, sans-serif; white-space: nowrap; background: transparent; color: oklch(0.730 0.018 245); cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.65, 0, 0.35, 1), color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.65, 0, 0.35, 1); } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: oklch(0.255 0.016 245); color: oklch(0.920 0.010 245); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(0.545 0.180 250); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Danger Button
components.description: Destructive intent only; Alert Red fill, deepens on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-danger { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; padding: 8px 16px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid transparent; font: 500 0.875rem/1.4 'Figtree', system-ui, sans-serif; white-space: nowrap; background: oklch(0.540 0.190 025); color: rgb(248 250 253); cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.65, 0, 0.35, 1), transform 120ms cubic-bezier(0.65, 0, 0.35, 1); } .ds-btn-danger:hover { background: oklch(0.480 0.180 025); } .ds-btn-danger:active { transform: scale(0.98); } .ds-btn-danger:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(0.545 0.180 250); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Input Field
components.description: Recessed sunken field, ≥3:1 edge, accent caret, focus border + 40% ring.
components.html: <input class="ds-input" type="text" placeholder="Search for notes, exams, courses..." />
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; padding: 8px 12px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid oklch(0.520 0.024 245); background: oklch(0.255 0.016 245); color: oklch(0.920 0.010 245); font: 400 0.875rem/1.5 'Figtree', system-ui, sans-serif; caret-color: oklch(0.545 0.180 250); transition: border-color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.65, 0, 0.35, 1), box-shadow 120ms cubic-bezier(0.65, 0, 0.35, 1); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: oklch(0.640 0.016 245); } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: oklch(0.545 0.180 250); box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px oklch(0.545 0.180 250 / 0.40); }

components.name: Interactive Card
components.description: Raised surface, hairline edge; hover lifts 2 px and brightens the edge — one gesture.
components.css: .ds-card { padding: 20px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid oklch(0.315 0.020 245); background: oklch(0.200 0.014 245); color: oklch(0.920 0.010 245); font: 400 0.875rem/1.6 'Figtree', system-ui, sans-serif; transition: border-color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.65, 0, 0.35, 1), transform 180ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-card:hover { border-color: oklch(0.520 0.024 245); transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-card h3 { margin: 0 0 6px; font: 700 1.125rem/1.3 'Bricolage Grotesque', 'Figtree', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-card p { margin: 0; color: oklch(0.730 0.018 245); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

components.name: Badge
components.description: Quiet metadata chip on sunken field.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid oklch(0.315 0.020 245); background: oklch(0.255 0.016 245); color: oklch(0.730 0.018 245); font: 500 0.75rem/1.4 'Figtree', system-ui, sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

components.name: Accent Badge
components.description: Harbor Blue as a whisper: 10% fill, sky text, 30% edge.
components.css: .ds-badge-accent { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid oklch(0.545 0.180 250 / 0.30); background: oklch(0.545 0.180 250 / 0.10); color: oklch(0.780 0.115 250); font: 500 0.75rem/1.4 'Figtree', system-ui, sans-serif; }

components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 16px; padding: 12px 24px; background: oklch(0.200 0.014 245); border-bottom: 1px solid oklch(0.315 0.020 245); font: 500 0.875rem/1.4 'Figtree', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-nav-brand { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav-tile { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 28px; height: 28px; border-radius: 8px; background: oklch(0.545 0.180 250); color: rgb(248 250 253); font-weight: 700; } .ds-nav-word { color: oklch(0.920 0.010 245); font: 700 1rem/1.2 'Bricolage Grotesque', 'Figtree', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-nav-links { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 20px; } .ds-nav-link { color: oklch(0.730 0.018 245); text-decoration: none; transition: color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.65, 0, 0.35, 1); } .ds-nav-link:hover, .ds-nav-link.is-active { color: oklch(0.920 0.010 245); } .ds-nav-cta { padding: 6px 12px; border-radius: 8px; background: oklch(0.545 0.180 250); color: rgb(248 250 253); } .ds-nav-cta:hover { background: oklch(0.500 0.170 250); } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(0.545 0.180 250); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Skeleton
components.description: Signature loading surface: sunken field with a single translating sheen.
components.css: .ds-skeleton { position: relative; overflow: hidden; border-radius: 8px; background: oklch(0.255 0.016 245); } .ds-skeleton::after { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 0; transform: translateX(-100%); background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, oklch(0.920 0.010 245 / 0.06), transparent); animation: ds-shimmer 1.6s infinite; } @keyframes ds-shimmer { to { transform: translateX(100%); } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-skeleton::after { animation: none; } }

narrative.overview:
A quiet, always-open library at night. The whole system is a dark, midnight-blue room — surfaces are near-black planes tinted toward a single azure hue (OKLCH hue 245, no pure grays anywhere) — and one harbor-blue light marks everything that matters: links, primary actions, focus, the way forward. Nothing glows, nothing shouts; the room is calm so the material on the shelves can be trusted.

The hall keeps its doors open and its shelf layout legible. Access is free and ungatekept (every public action is reachable in a click or two), and academic structure is the map: departments, courses, and semesters organize the shelves exactly the way students think. The interface's job is to disappear behind that structure — comfortable density, scanable tables, honest empty states.

Components are refined and restrained at rest but tactile in the hand: a single hover gesture (a small lift or a border brighten, never both plus a glow), a satisfying press (scale 0.98), instant focus. Efficient and unpretentious — the design would rather be a good study room than a showcase.
keyCharacteristics: Dark-only system (color-scheme: dark); three surface elevations, all tinted hue 245
One anchor accent (Harbor Blue); status hues appear only as state, violet only as category marks
Flat at rest; depth appears only as feedback (lift, border brighten, press scale)
Composited motion only (transform/opacity), exponential ease-out, staggered entrances at 45 ms
Tabular figures on every data-heavy number; balanced line breaks on every heading
Lucide icons at 16–24 px, stroke 2; never emoji as UI icons

rules.name: The One Hue Rule
rules.body: Harbor Blue is the only chromatic hero. Status hues speak only when state changes; violet only marks categories. If a new screen needs "more color," the answer is more structure, not more hues.

rules.name: The Tinted Neutral Rule
rules.body: There are no pure grays. Every neutral in the system carries hue 245; a stock palette gray or a #fff/#000 is off-system by definition (legacy bridged classes resolve to themed tokens — new code uses tokens directly).

rules.name: The Two-Edge Rule
rules.body: Edges have exactly three strengths: Subtle for decoration, Field for anything interactive, Hover for the hover state of Field. Never invent a fourth brightness.

rules.name: The Tabular Figure Rule
rules.body: Any number that will be scanned, compared, or counted (stats, sizes, table columns) gets tabular-nums. Prose numbers don't.

rules.name: The Balanced Headline Rule
rules.body: Every heading wraps with text-wrap: balance; every prose paragraph with text-wrap: pretty. The type sets itself up to look intentional at any width.

rules.name: The One-Signal Rule
rules.body: A hover state changes one thing about a component as a single gesture — a lift with its edge brighten, or a color shift — never a stack of color + shadow + motion. If two signals compete, the quieter one wins.

dos: Do use the semantic token classes (bg-background-secondary, text-text-secondary, border-border-subtle) for all new UI; resolve every color through the theme.
Do check every new neutral carries the tint — if it reads as pure gray on midnight, it's off-system.
Do give interactive elements exactly one hover gesture, 120–180 ms, exponential ease-out.
Do set tabular-nums on every scanned number and text-wrap: balance on every heading.
Do use lucide icons at 16–24 px (stroke 2) wrapped in accessible names; put icons on icon tiles (Sunken Field, 8 px radius).
Do honor prefers-reduced-motion: opacity-only feedback, no spatial movement, no infinite loops.
donts: Don't introduce stock palette steps (blue-500, gray-400) in new code — the legacy bridge exists so old markup renders on-theme, not as an invitation.
Don't stack hover signals (glow + lift + color) or add resting shadows to flat surfaces.
Don't use uppercase/letter-spaced label caps, glued arrows in copy ("Upload your first file →"), or middle-dot separators — hierarchy is weight and color, not typographic noise.
Don't animate layout properties (width, height, top/left); movement is composited transform only.
Don't remove or fade-in focus rings; focus is instant and always visible.
Don't use emoji as UI icons or invent a second accent hue.
